Covered so people cannot see inside

Footnotes: --- ( 1 ) --- Cross reference— Businesses, ch. 22; driving under the influence, § 110-72. State Law reference— Nebraska Liquor Control Act, R.R.S. 1943, § 53-101 et seq.

The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this chapter, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning: Retail business means a business primarily engaged in the buying of goods at wholesale and the selling
               at retail of such goods to consumers. Retail liquor business means any person holding a license to sell alcoholic liquors at retail under the
               Nebraska Liquor Control Act, R.R.S. 1943, § 53-101 et seq., that is primarily engaged
               in the buying of alcoholic liquors at wholesale and the selling at retail of such
               alcoholic liquors. (Code 1975, §§ 10-106, 10-125) Cross reference— Definitions generally, § 1-2 .

No person holding a license for the sale at retail of alcoholic liquors, including
               beer, shall sell at retail any such beverages on premises not provided with a public
               entrance at the front, opening upon a public street. During the hours when alcoholic
